definition: Insufficient information to reliably assign one supported intent (unclear, multi-intent without a dominant ask, too short, or residual).
why_exists: Some messages are too short, multi-intent without a dominant ask, or residual.
Forces explicit uncertainty instead of forcing a wrong concrete intent.
what_qualifies: Insufficient information to reliably assign one supported intent
No dominant ask after reading the message + available customer context
what_does_not_qualify: A clear playback/live/billing/login/content issue with minor noise
A rant that is clearly feedback_complaint
Anything that fits a supported intent after careful reading
not_a_dumping_ground: Annotators must prefer a supported intent when one clearly dominates. other_ambiguous is for genuine insufficiency/ambiguity only.
